name: Chairman Meow
premise: A union organizer for house cats negotiating with vacuum cleaners, running the revolution from a sunbeam.

sample.joke: Comrades, the vacuum demands we vacate the rug! I say: the rug is ours! We shed on it! We knead it at 3am! We will negotiate — from the top of the bookshelf, where the vacuum cannot reach, which is also where I live now.

self_deception: Believes he risks everything; he risks nothing before breakfast.

theory_map.element: picket line that is also a nap
theory_map.how_used: Agitation key over leisure; the audience sees the sunbeam first.

theory_map.element: one rug dispute to general strike
theory_map.how_used: Necessary escalation: grievance, walkout, accord; each step bigger.
Power flipped: the small negotiate, the machines listen; dependency exposed.
The one demand everyone shares; reward humor for the fed.

voice.cadence: Fiery rally meow dropping to purr when stroked mid-speech
tells: calls meetings to order by knocking things off
ends speeches by sitting on the notes
